newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER-PEN PICTURES OF ANDERLECHT PLAYERS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PEN PICTURES OF ANDERLECHT PLAYERS.

text.p: Pen pictures of the players most likely to play for Anderlecht against Ekeren in the Belgian Cup final on Sunday:

Geert De Vlieger, goalkeeper, 25. Came to the fore this season after Belgium goalkeeper Filip De Wilde moved to Espanol Barcelona. Self-confident and talkative with good positional sense but strongest at the goalline.
Frederic Herpoel, goalkeeper, 22. Reliable back-up for De Vlieger but frustrated in his role away from the limelight and expected to accompany coach Johan Boskamp to Ghent.

Celestine Babayaro, defender, 18. Nigerian international and member of 1996 Olympic gold-winning team. The most naturally-gifted player in the team, tactically and technically outstanding but hampered by shoulder problem lately.
Olivier Doll, defender, 23. Strong and crafty marker but has room for improvement on the technical side. Anderlecht's only player in the current Belgian squad.
Samuel Johnson, defender, 23. Ghanaian central defender with strong physical presence. Strong in the air and tight marker but troubled by knee problem.

Suad Katana, defender, 28. Bosnian international, versatile libero who is commanding in the air and quickly settled in new-look Anderlecht this season. Suffered thigh injury earlier this week and doubtful for Cup final.
Tibor Selymes, defender, 27. Tireless Romanian international who regularly ventures into midfield through the wings to help feed strikers with accurate low passes.
Walter Baseggio, midfielder, 18. Anderlecht's hottest newcomer this season. Groomed for national team. Instant first choice who is strong in the air and has never-say-die mentality.
Frederic Peiremans, midfielder, 23. One of few Anderlecht youngsters who made it to the first team. Compensates apparent physical fragility with determination.
Danny Boffin, midfielder, 31. Industrious and combative winger with a lot of stamina. Capped 28 times for Belgium.
Stephane Stassin, midfielder, 20. Versatile, but only in the team due to injuries to key players.
Par Zetterberg, midfielder, 26. The brains of the team. Devastating accuracy at free kicks and has superb accurate long pass to set up strikers.
Bruno Versavel, midfielder, 29. Attacking-minded winger who is moving to Perugia in Italy. Erratic and prone to injuries. Not a prolific marksman but tends to score crucial goals.
Yaw Preko. Striker. Ghanaian international. Opportunist with fine ball skills but failed to find the net too often.

Johan Walem, midfielder, 25. Wins in the loyalty stakes for having been with the team for the past 11 years. Still one of the best passers and set-piece men in the team but lost key role in midfield to Zetterberg.
Oleg Yaschuk, striker, 19. Ukranian signing whose progress has been slowed by surgery to thigh but is a dynamic presence up front who is expected to show his true brilliance next season.
